scope: Every production definition, including hidden/unsupported definitions and legacy native imports
limits: Source/API-contract audit; no live character or game-data database was accessible. An API declaration does not verify a content ID or historical coverage.

books.assumptions: English title roster; books read before tracking cannot be recovered

collection.assumptions: Account journals deliberately excluded; historical bag-only items can be missed

consumables.historicalCoverage: Observed single-item bag decrease outside merchant/mail/trade/bank/auction
consumables.assumptions: Consumption is inferred; deletion or other bag changes can resemble eating; English food/drink classification

dungeons.historicalCoverage: Personal native criteria/statistics, context-bound native events or explicitly player-confirmed recovery, then observed kills
dungeons.assumptions: Shared account/OR criteria cannot identify the dungeon or character alone; recovery attestation and event context are labeled inferences; no multi-boss blanket credit; legacy head-quest fallback remains approximate

emotes.assumptions: English target/emote names and secure hooks; no historical emote log

exploration.historicalCoverage: Character-bound observed discoveries; personal matching native completion can recover
exploration.assumptions: Legacy overlay roster must match current maps; remote shared maps do not prove character history

fall.assumptions: Requires readable position and survival samples; no old fall history

fishing.historicalCoverage: Native statistics plus observed fishing windows
fishing.assumptions: Existing skill-minus-one floor and window/item units are approximate; retained, not newly verified

loot-rolls.assumptions: Pattern/name attribution and item quality need live locale/surname tests; no historical roll log

loremaster.historicalCoverage: Completed flags classified through optional QuestieDB
loremaster.assumptions: Legacy quest roster/continent thresholds need content verification

money.historicalCoverage: Verified native coin-unit total, else observed ledger
money.assumptions: Fallback ledger covers tracking period only

native.assumptions: Native adapter preserves character/account attribution; legacy imported rows are excluded from combined custom catalog

observed.assumptions: No durable pre-installation record verified; actual event/API depends on the listed objective

observed-kills.assumptions: Combat fields can be restricted; a disappearing living target no longer counts

ownership.historicalCoverage: Current item or known spell; recorded ownership
ownership.assumptions: Ownership can infer acquisition source; class-mount spell does not prove a specific quest path

pvp-observed.assumptions: No pre-installation history; scoreboard timing and surnames need live checks

pvp-statistics.assumptions: Legacy statistic IDs/units require live verification

quests.historicalCoverage: Native totals or exact completed quest flags
quests.assumptions: Unique flags approximate quest totals when statistic is unavailable

quickfish.assumptions: Dependency log is account-wide; not a native per-character lifetime counter

recipes.assumptions: Statistic identity/unit requires live verification; profession view/filter counts are not substituted

reputation.assumptions: Authored faction IDs, caps and account-wide reputation require live checks

riding.assumptions: Legacy spell IDs require live content checks

skills.historicalCoverage: Current rank or previously observed highest rank
skills.assumptions: Previously dropped professions cannot be reconstructed without exact native evidence

nativeFallbackPolicy: Only matching reference ID AND normalized title AND wasEarnedByMe=true. Dungeon fallback checks personal Spelunker criteria; shared account/OR criteria require exact instance/event context or explicit per-character player-confirmed recovery. Named single-boss completion and context/recovery are labeled inferences.
